_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 19 = FALA (aula impar) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): quantificadores com nuance (few x a few, little x a little, plenty of, hardly any; contavel x incontavel). E o ponto da antiga aula 14 (contaveis/incontaveis + how much/how many, escrito em B1) elevado para B2. Tema bloco H (Rio x Sao Paulo); fato dono: o frio de Sao Paulo. Video em aula (SciShow Kids, YouTube nocookie). Vozes iguais as aulas 1-18.

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the bus stop and I'm freezing. There's so much fog that I can hardly see the street. I have a few minutes before the bus, so I'm calling you. There are hardly any warm days left, and I have only one hoodie! Can I borrow a few layers for the school trip? Oh, and bring a little hot chocolate if you can. There's plenty of space in my bag!
